ignore.frame: Frame counters differ by design: each side settles with its own state graph.
ignore.stack: State stacks are informational; the web merges several Python states (docs/parity/states.md).
ignore.game_vars._combat_random_seed: Web-only: the web persists the combat LCG in game vars; compared via rng.combat instead.
ignore.game_vars.money: Web-only mirror of the party's money (give_money and shops also set this game var); party money is compared as `money`.
ignore.level_vars._initial_turn_events_after_le: Web-only bookkeeping flag set by GameState.loadLevel.
ignore.level_vars._turn1_upkeep_done: Web-only bookkeeping flag for the first status upkeep.
ignore.units.*.skill_data.*.positionStatusSourc: Web-only bookkeeping on terrain/region statuses (Python tracks these in game.terrain_status_registry).
ignore.units.*.skill_data.*.sourceType: Web-only: the web stores a skill's source in skill.data; Python keeps it in the unit's skill source list.
ignore.units.*.skill_data.*.ability_item_uid: Python stores the uid of a skill's ability item (engine-specific uid counter).
ignore.units.*.skill_data.*.abilityItemKey:abil: Web-only registry key of a skill's ability item (see ability_item_uid).
ignore.units.*.skill_data.*.itemSource: Web-only: item-granted skills remember their item in skill.data (Python: the unit's skill source list).

zero_equals_missing.units.*.stats.*: Python keeps one entry per DB stat; the web may add class-only stats (e.g. LEAD) at 0.
zero_equals_missing.units.*.wexp.*: Both sides drop zero wexp; a type missing on one side equals 0.
zero_equals_missing.units.*.growth_points.*: Both sides drop zero growth points.

false_equals_missing.units.*.skill_data.*.active: Python's combat-art components initialise data['active'] = False; the web sets it only when the art is toggled.

null_equals_empty.units.*.ai_group: Python uses None for no AI group, the web an empty string.

unordered.units.*.skills: Compared as a multiset: the web applies terrain statuses before class skills at level load (see README, Known diffs).
